heuristics.text: Freshness first: a topic earns a tab only through a dated news catalyst (NEW) or a dated delta on an open situation (RUNNING); a watch-list theme never selects a topic.

Lease walk-aways move AI credit risk from tenants to lenders: when a hyperscaler declines a renewal and distressed sites change hands ([[F04]]), price construction debt off the rescue value, not the lease.
PIK preferreds are the leading edge: a [[F17]] PIK preferred moving to non-accrual ([[F16]]) signals where BDC income will be cut next.

Independence before echo: at least one NEW topic must come from Chrizza's own open sweep. Today the native sweep found the lender-takeover endgame (Out West [[F108]] bid, Karyopharm [[F112]] equity) that the upstream macro feed did not frame, and it contradicted an upstream debt figure.
